message:
fix: add SymbolicRef to git mocks and ignore local config

WHY
Tests involving branch references failed because the git interface mocks lacked the SymbolicRef method, and local configuration directories were being tracked.

WHAT
* Implemented SymbolicRef in mockGit for prreview handler tests and classifier tests.
* Added .git-courer/ to .gitignore to prevent local server state from being committed.
